# ElementFilterMembership <span class="sd-sphinx-override sd-badge sd-outline-primary sd-text-primary">SysML</span><a href="#elementfiltermembership-sysml" class="headerlink" title="Link to this heading"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>

*<span class="pre">class</span><span class="w"> </span>*<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">ElementFilterMembership</span></span><a href="#syside.ElementFilterMembership" class="headerlink" title="Link to this definition"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>  
Implementation of <span class="pre">`ElementFilterMembership`</span> defined in the KerML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> <span class="pre">`ElementFilterMembership`</span> is a <span class="pre">`Membership`</span> between a <span class="pre">`Namespace`</span> and a model-level evaluable <span class="pre">`Boolean`</span>-valued <span class="pre">`Expression`</span>, asserting that imported <span class="pre">`members`</span> of the <span class="pre">`Namespace`</span> should be filtered using the <span class="pre">`condition`</span> <span class="pre">`Expression`</span>. A general <span class="pre">`Namespace`</span> does not define any specific filtering behavior, but such behavior may be defined for various specialized kinds of <span class="pre">`Namespaces`</span>.
>
> </div>

For language description, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=49" class="reference external" target="_blank">7.2.5.4</a> of the KerML specification. For more details on the model, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=262" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.4.13.2</a> of the KerML specification.

> <div>
>

>
